decisions.reason: The construction alternatives preserve the existing requirement that the second V remain elevated above E and L. The same-message hierarchy-reference change is already fully represented.

The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the second V from the locked-assets list while retaining the approved Hero V and É accent, fully capturing the necessary impact of reopening second-V construction.

The source message separately changes the spacing reference, and that same-message MODIFY is already fully represented under this Requirement. The second-V construction alternatives require no additional kerning-state change.
The approved Hero V remains the unchanged master geometry used to construct the second V; the source decision does not alter the Hero V itself.
The source changes how the second V is constructed and does not change the É accent's literal derivation from the approved Hero V terminal.
The requested second-V alternatives do not alter the required peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent.
The source requests second-V alternatives and word-level spacing adjustments but does not change the established construction, proportions, or architectural vocabulary of the E and L letterforms.
The second-V construction alternatives do not change the selected all-caps case treatment.
The source concerns vector construction and optical spacing and does not resume or modify the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
Describing two requested construction alternatives does not change the standing requirement to provide a short rationale with each design round.
The source does not address preview-file formats or accessibility.
